Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/controller/PasswordRecoveryController.java only.
- @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/auth/recovery') @CrossOrigin
- Autowire PasswordRecoveryService via constructor injection.
- Endpoints:
  * @PostMapping('/forgot-password'): accepts Map with 'email', calls passwordRecoveryService.requestPasswordReset(email), returns 200 OK with message 'If account exists, instructions have been sent.'
  * @PostMapping('/reset-password'): accepts Map with 'token' and 'newPassword', calls passwordRecoveryService.resetPassword(token, newPassword), returns 200 OK with {success: true}
  * @PostMapping('/verify-email'): accepts Map with 'token', calls passwordRecoveryService.verifyEmail(token), returns 200 OK with {verified: true}
- Include clean ExceptionHandler for IllegalArgumentException (400) and ResponseStatusException.
